Background: a sunlit white-washed courtyard with a pale tiled floor, an arched doorway at normal height, low stone steps and a waist-high wall, lit by natural light with soft shadows on the skin, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor.
